value.title: Foundation acceptance proof selection — not execution evidence

value.criterion: An external Rust application consumes the SDK from the checkout through ordinary Cargo dependency configuration and invokes the configuration/diagnostic use case in-process, without spawning the CLI or requiring a daemon, database, ML service or caller-created async runtime.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: external-consumer Cargo fixture invoking the public SDK; include the behavioral test in the future cargo test --workspace lane. No product Cargo workspace exists yet.
value.probe: Current repository contains only planning/harness setup; Flowspace3 core/public library patterns inspected.

value.criterion: The shared configuration use case accepts a documented minimal configuration for caller-supplied source roots, produces the effective settings and diagnostics deterministically, treats an empty root list as valid, and rejects malformed documents, blank root entries and incompatible value types with field/path-specific errors rather than panicking or substituting guessed values. It does not inspect session content.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: table-driven public configuration tests, invalid-input boundaries and deterministic repeated calls under cargo test --workspace; exact configuration syntax is fixed by the reviewed guide.
value.probe: Flowspace3 pure config resolve/validation source inspected; no corresponding Unisphere implementation exists.

value.criterion: Configuration precedence is documented and identical in SDK and CLI: defaults are overridden by explicitly supplied configuration, then explicit caller/CLI overrides; omitted values retain defaults. Library calls do not read ambient HOME, process environment or global config implicitly.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: precedence matrix and injected-context tests with conflicting defaults/document/overrides and a hostile ambient HOME/env fixture; future cargo test --workspace.
value.probe: Flowspace3 pure layering and sealed subprocess helpers inspected; this plan intentionally does not inherit its full FS3_* environment namespace.

value.criterion: The installable CLI exposes help/version and the shared configuration/diagnostic operation; on equivalent successful and invalid inputs its semantic data/error agrees with direct SDK invocation. A missing or unreadable explicit config file produces a named failure, not success or an empty configuration.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: real CLI subprocess smoke against temporary valid/malformed/missing/unreadable configuration plus direct SDK comparison; wired into the future harness boot/checks lane.
value.probe: Existing boot/checks extensions are unconfigured and provide no product smoke; Flowspace3 CLI contract tests are reference material only.

value.criterion: Machine-mode CLI output has a documented versioned success/error envelope and remains parseable without terminal decoration; explicit output selection takes precedence over terminal detection, and piped/captured output defaults to machine mode. Human output is derived from the same result, logs do not corrupt stdout, and successful operations, operational/configuration failures and invalid CLI invocation have documented distinct exit behavior.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: pipe/PTY-or-injected-terminal/output-selection/error-routing subprocess cases and SDK/CLI result parity under cargo test --workspace; exact flags/envelope keys belong to the guide.
value.probe: Flowspace3 core/output.rs and core/envelope.rs inspected; reusing patterns does not adopt their command vocabulary or telemetry payload schema.

value.criterion: Public failures are actionable and typed: callers can distinguish invalid configuration from explicit input I/O failures without parsing prose; CLI failures carry a stable category/code, a useful location when known and remediation guidance, without dumping secrets, full config documents or unrelated session content.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: typed failure matching, hostile-value redaction and CLI error-envelope checks with deterministic injected failures; future cargo test --workspace.
value.probe: Flowspace3 catalog/envelope source inspected; no Unisphere taxonomy or implementation exists yet.

value.criterion: Foundation services are executable in isolation through their public contracts with injected dependencies before a CLI or sibling adapter implementation exists; automated dependency checks reject core/service dependencies on the CLI or concrete outer adapters, and a deliberate forbidden-edge fixture makes the check fail.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: independent service contract suite plus a dependency-rule negative fixture checked through the future architecture check and harness checks. Exact crate layout/rules are authored in the guide.
value.probe: Flowspace3 testkit architecture allowlist and fake-source contract patterns inspected; user explicitly requires parallel service construction without CLI completion.

value.criterion: Tests and smoke scenarios are deterministic, parallel-safe and isolated from real user configuration/session stores: temporary paths and explicit injected settings are used, foundation operations do not write outside supplied test/workspace paths or start hidden background workers, and ordinary library invocation performs no network calls.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: isolated concurrent service calls and sealed CLI smoke with sentinel HOME/config/producer-store paths; assert no unexpected writes or external requests under cargo test --workspace.
value.probe: Flowspace3 sealed process test helper inspected; no product side-effect surface is implemented.

value.criterion: A fresh checkout with the documented Rust toolchain and declared dependencies can build/test the SDK and install/run the CLI locally; SDK consumption and the installed CLI do not require Node/DD/Builder tooling at runtime, repository-private absolute paths, or unpublished sibling binaries.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: clean external consumer manifest, documented cargo build/test and cargo install --path usage; execute installed CLI smoke from outside the workspace. Initial proof target is the host platform, with other support claims limited to observed CI evidence.
value.probe: Current setup uses repo-local DD only for planning; no Rust manifest/lockfile/package exists yet.

value.criterion: The repository engineering harness exposes one real product validation lane and a meaningful foundation boot/smoke lane; a passing lane proves the delivered configuration/SDK/CLI behavior and must not claim native telemetry collection or reader support. A deliberately failing product check propagates a failing verdict.
value.proof: EXTEND→RUN: replace current unconfigured checks/boot implementation with the future Rust validation and assembled SDK/CLI smoke, then run harness checks --json and harness boot --json with success/failure cases.
value.probe: Read .harness/engineering-harness.md: existing checks/boot are explicitly unconfigured; prior harness composition tests prove only envelope behavior.

value.criterion: A new consumer can follow documented SDK and CLI examples to reproduce a successful configuration check and an actionable failure; docs state foundation-only capabilities and version/support limits, and any substantial Flowspace3/git-ai code reuse retains applicable licence and provenance notices.
value.proof: BUILD→RUN: executable SDK rustdoc/example and documented CLI smoke; review current capability/notice documentation against shipped behavior. This is not registry publication or broad platform support.
value.probe: Flowspace3 LICENSE and concrete reuse candidates inspected; no Unisphere product usage docs exist yet.
